toolbarReport.methodology: Public NSToolbarItem label and paletteLabel identify three unique actual item.views under the single same-window AXToolbar NSView. identifier records the real itemIdentifier, separately from the logical auditKey. Live NSView.convert(bounds,to:nil) and window.convertToScreen supply geometry; no AX client activation or private class selection. The original PNG uses top-left coordinates and observed scale. Central square is 60% of the smaller control dimension, excluding the platter border. sRGB relative luminance p95/p05 contrast must reach 3:1. No image editing, fixed screen coordinates, fallback rendering or visual retry.
